output:
## Fixed

- Corrected the way flags are passed to `re.sub`, fixing pattern substitution errors.  
- Changed Bash shell completion to show a warning instead of raising an error when the version check fails, preventing crashes during completion.  
- Restored semicolon line endings in the Fish shell completion script, improving its reliability.
